instruction: Warehouse And Office Annex Model This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create an OpenStudio warehouse with office annex model and save the required output as result.osm. 1. The output folder contains result.osm with size at least 500 bytes. 2. Result.osm contains exactly one OS:Version object whose version identifier starts with 3.10. 3. Result.osm contains exactly 1 OS:BuildingStory, 2 OS:Space objects, and 2 OS:ThermalZone objects. 4. The OS:Space names are exactly Warehouse and Office Annex. 5. Every OS:Space references the OS:BuildingStory, references an OS:ThermalZone, and has floor area greater than 0.05 m2. 6. The model has exactly 13 OS:Surface objects: 2 Floor surfaces, 2 RoofCeiling surfaces, and 9 Wall surfaces. 7. The surface Outside Boundary Condition counts are exactly 2 Ground, 9 Outdoors, and 2 Surface. 8. The model has exactly 3 OS:SubSurface objects, all counted window subsurfaces are FixedWindow, and the fixed-window count is exactly 3. 9. The model contains exactly 2 OS:ZoneHVAC:IdealLoadsAirSystem objects, 2 OS:ZoneHVAC:EquipmentList objects, and 2 OS:ThermostatSetpoint:DualSetpoint objects. 10. The surface geometry bounding box has X span 28.00 m, Y span 12.00 m, and Z span 6.00 m, each with tolerance +/-0.05 m. 11. The sum of floor surface areas is 288.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. 12. The sum of exterior wall gross areas is 435.20 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. 13. The total fixed-window area is 17.60 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
